transform: Coordinates are unrounded float results of frame.hand + R(angle) * (weapon.point - weapon.pivot) minus frame.anchor; mirror entire X for facing left.

jump.sampling: Choose by physics phase; never loop all four poses

idle.note: Reuses the exact same body frame; not counted as an independent animation pose

stagger.note: Explicit reuse of existing recoil pose; no new generated animation frame

pushed.note: Explicit reuse of existing recoil pose; no new generated animation frame
